name: Sven's Camp
summary: In Duskwood's western hills, Sven Yorgen still grieves for his slain family and seeks answers. A journal buried at his ruined farm may tell who saw the massacre.

sections.title: A Clue in the Dirt
sections.body: You find a small, dirt-stained book beneath freshly turned earth at the ruined Yorgen farm. Dark riders struck while Sven Yorgen was away, leaving his family dead and the farm in ruins. Grief and vengeance sent his allies to search the wreckage. Someone had hastily hidden the book there.

sections.title: A Silent Witness
sections.body: At his camp in the western hills, Sven learns what the journal holds. Its entries show that an unknown figure watched his family's massacre. The discovery brings no peace. Sven now seeks the onlooker and demands answers.

faq.q: What is the book found in the mound of dirt?
faq.answer: The book is a small, untitled, dirt-stained journal buried at the Yorgen farm. Its entries show that an unidentified onlooker watched the massacre of Sven Yorgen's family.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
faq.answer: Delivering the book to Sven Yorgen begins a search for the mysterious witness and leads into The Shadowy Figure.

aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Sven has taken refuge in a camp in Duskwood's northwestern hills. He grieves for his family and plots retribution.

faq.q: Why was the book buried at the farm?
faq.answer: The book lay hidden in loose dirt amid the ruined homestead. The observer at the scene may have discarded or concealed it in haste.
Dark riders from Deadwind Pass slaughtered Sven's family while he was away from the farm.

faq.q: What faction can complete this quest?
faq.answer: Only Alliance members can help Sven Yorgen, who seeks aid from Duskwood's defenders and the Alliance.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can help investigate the Yorgen massacre while the Alliance struggles to understand the dark forces encroaching on Duskwood.
